import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

# Let's inspect cabinet in obs1 and obs20
im1 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0001.png'))
im20 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0020.png'))

# In obs1:
# Cabinet is right in front of camera slightly to the right:
# Let's see the cabinet white top and bottom
# u around 285 to 357, v around 298 to 404
m_cab1 = (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 295) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 280) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 365) & (im1[:,:,0] > 100) & (im1[:,:,1] > 100)
coords1 = np.argwhere(m_cab1)
print("Cab obs1: u in [{}, {}], v in [{}, {}]".format(coords1[:,1].min(), coords1[:,1].max(), coords1[:,0].min(), coords1[:,0].max()))

# In obs20 (cam is at (-0.5, 2.0, yaw=0)):
m_cab20 = (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 340) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 380) & (im20[:,:,0] > 100) & (im20[:,:,1] > 100)
coords20 = np.argwhere(m_cab20)
print("Cab obs20: u in [{}, {}], v in [{}, {}]".format(coords20[:,1].min(), coords20[:,1].max(), coords20[:,0].min(), coords20[:,0].max()))

# Ground contact of cabinet:
# In obs1, the bottom of the cabinet front face:
# Let's find bottom-most pixel of cabinet front
v_cab1_bot = coords1[:,0].max()
u_cab1_bot = (coords1[:,1].min() + coords1[:,1].max()) / 2.0
print("Cab obs1 ground contact: u={}, v={}".format(u_cab1_bot, v_cab1_bot))

# Let's check d_fwd from ground contact:
# d_fwd = 1.55 * 256 / (v - 256)
d_fwd1 = 1.55 * 256.0 / (v_cab1_bot - 256.0)
d_right1 = 1.55 * (u_cab1_bot - 256.0) / (v_cab1_bot - 256.0)
print("Cab obs1 pos from ground contact: x={:.2f}, y={:.2f}".format(d_right1, d_fwd1))
